objective: 在Phase56结构搜索仍明显高于合同阈值后，执行预注册的多模型族、误差驱动、多轮OOF优化；只有OOF和一次性development validation同时满足合同，才允许后续blind freeze。

execution.environment: remote CPU or local CPU; GPU is unnecessary

dataset_contract.group_isolation: all six model rows of one profile remain in one OOF fold
dataset_contract.final_input: low-dimensional profile, model structure and fixed P1/D1 execution features only
dataset_contract.arrival_features: excluded because the target is fixed-draining and arrival-time invariant

search_contract.stop_early_only_if: OOF target, strict H0 protection, and all model/segment guards are true
search_contract.adaptive_signal: OOF-only signed per-bin bias, model/segment guard failures, support mismatch and candidate diversity
search_contract.blend_selection: convex weights selected only from OOF predictions; no validation target is used

predictor_contract.semantic: H0 plus target-free residual; TP/PP/PD execution configuration is input, scheduler placement/topology is not selected here
predictor_contract.support_rule: learned only from fit-fold target support; never infer support from validation
predictor_contract.validation_rule: freeze round, candidate, blend weights, alpha, calibrators and epoch from OOF before opening the 240 validation profiles once

acceptance_gate.oof_protection: overall and every model/segment strictly beat H0 on calls WAPE, bytes WAPE, calls TV and normalized payload EMD
acceptance_gate.model_histogram: each of six models has calls and bytes histogram WAPE <= 0.15
acceptance_gate.segment_histogram: each BurstGPT segment has calls and bytes histogram WAPE <= 0.15 and composite ratio < 1
acceptance_gate.total_wape: overall calls and bytes total WAPE <= 0.05
acceptance_gate.next_phase_permitted: only when OOF protection and all one-shot validation gates pass
acceptance_gate.negative_policy: integrity PASS with target_met=false is valid evidence; it blocks blind evaluation and requires a new hypothesis, not blind retuning

stop_and_block_if: Phase50 blind, Phase49 freeze, raw or complete requests are opened
validation targets are used to generate candidates, select rounds, tune alpha, tune blend weights or choose epochs
candidate count exceeds the hard budget
GPU, network, model download, original weights or cache is accessed
an existing result directory is overwritten
claim_boundary: development-only evidence on the frozen Phase48 compact six-model data
not fresh blind evidence and not a Phase50 re-evaluation
not physical communication time, placement, latency, queueing, overlap or online scheduling
